scope: Correct a native count-propagation gap below prior mock tests; focused definitions and executed regression, not new source-unit approval.
mapping: Pinned C preserves successful prefix counts after closing a file; failed close or negative reads remain errors.
The preceding CIU C service rejected every short read before Rust read_some_at could see its count; injecting above it missed that regression.
Production ck_lfs_read now returns a bounded nonnegative count only after successful close and cache erasure. read_at remains exact in both Rust adapters.
Engine::read separately rejects short/excessive whole-record loads, preserving prior complete-record semantics.

The real native composition uses the FFI StorageBackend, actual transaction engine and production C service with LittleFS over modeled flash. Its file-read seam supplies only the requested prefix, poisoning the unreported suffix.
All30 response/fault/recovery cases execute actual Core routing, ordinary presence and independent registration/attestation verification. The fixture asserts service file-cache erasure on every read.
remaining: Direct MCU execution of the CIU Rust adapter, physical flash/USB/RF, open/seek/close fault breadth, cancellations/IRQ schedules, runtime resources, Linux sanitizer result and full source audit remain open.
